findings.invariant: fixedDistance and fixedDistanceUnit are one persisted physical measurement
findings.summary: current settings summary preserves the stored pair; label-only replacement can misrepresent physical distance
findings.editor: current editor combines stored number with live workspace unit and can re-stamp an unchanged number into a new unit
findings.auto_unit_correction: government auto-update can correct custom-unit attributes.unit without migrating commuterExclusions
findings.calculation: runtime converts the persisted pair from its stored unit into the request unit before subtracting it
findings.precision_blocker: editor is integer-only and strips non-digits, so ordinary km/mi conversion cannot round-trip decimals safely
findings.hostile_legacy_edge: missing fixedDistanceUnit falls back to current workspace unit in summary but to miles in runtime calculation

recommended_acceptance: never pair a stored numeric value with a different unit label without conversion
no-edit Save after unit drift must not change physical distance
cover manual and government-auto unit changes
make legacy missing-unit fallback consistent between UI and calculation
